messages:
claire: Heads-up  Action Item A12 from the recent postmortem (link in tracker) is overdue. Owner: @ben. Can you post a quick status and ETA? We're trying to close the loop before engineering sync tomorrow. :wave:

ben: Sorry, got pulled into the release. Blocker was identifying the root cause of repeated GC pauses in dedicated GPU pools. I have a profiling trace and a proposed GC guard change in a branch: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/5120 (WIP). ETA for PR + smoke: 36h.

irfan: If this is 36h, we need an interim mitigation for affected Dedicated customers. Can you toggle the per-cluster GC throttle while you finish?

ben: I can add a per-cluster throttle flag; that'll be a small config change and we can flip it without deploy. Will PR it as a hotfix.

ops-bot: Reminder: Action Item A12 assigned to ben is overdue (due 1819370389). Please update the incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-402/actions.

sara: Also worth noting we saw similar GC pauses in two previous incidents. Can we add a recurrence tag and a short remediation note if this fixes it?

ben: Good call. I'll add a recurrence note in the postmortem and the tracker when merged. Hotfix PR coming in ~20m.

[20m later]

ben: Hotfix PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/5121. Adds `cluster.gc_throttle` toggle + smoke test. Asking for quick review.

irfan: Reviewing now. Quick question: does throttle change affect latency SLOs? Need SRE sign-off to avoid flipping in-prod blindly.

ben: Throttle reduces background GC aggressiveness only, should increase p99 latency slightly for a short window but avoid full pauses. Added note in PR and a metric dashboard link.

ops-bot: CI passed for PR 5121. Canary in dedicated-us-west routed to two clusters, both green at 1819459189.

claire: Thanks. @ben once you merge, update the tracker and add the recurrence note about "GC pause pattern on Dedicated pools". We'll close A12 as resolved then follow up with the deeper perf fix.

ben: Merged, updated tracker and postmortem with recurrence tag. Also created follow-on low-priority action for the full GC refactor assigned to me.

ops-bot: Action Item A12 status updated to closed by ben at 1819460289.

sara: Verified tracker and PM. Closing Action Item A12. :white_check_mark:

claire: Great work getting this across the line. Closing thread. :tada:
